title: Vivi2D Evaluation Texture Plan v1
$comment: Machine-readable freeze artifact adopted by Spec Freeze Amendment 1. The plan implicitly selects decoder profile vivi2d.png.rgba8.v1. Standard JSON Schema cannot enforce sorted output, projected ID uniqueness, the payload-to-plan 1:1 relation, decoded aggregate pixels, or the per-plan aggregate RGBA-byte ceiling.

textures.$comment: IDs must be unique and bindings must be emitted in ascending id order. The set must be in a 1:1 relation with payload atlases after applying the atlas: prefix. Semantic limits are sum(width * height) <= 67108864 pixels and sum(width * height * 4) <= 268435456 bytes.

Sha256HexV1.$comment: Wire input accepts either hex case. Producers emit lowercase; consumers normalize for equality and lookup.

TextureDimensionV1.$comment: Concrete per-axis limit adopted for decoder profile vivi2d.png.rgba8.v1 by Spec Freeze Amendment 1.

sizeBytes.$comment: Per-PNG max input bytes for decoder profile vivi2d.png.rgba8.v1.

then.$comment: For blob, objectAddress must equal contentSha256; equality is semantic.

EvaluationTextureBindingV1.$comment: Declared dimensions must equal the decoded PNG IHDR dimensions. asset.mediaType and this mediaType are both fixed to image/png.
